text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An academy alumna arrived as a special lecturer.
Since observing the class was allowed,
I came to check out Katsuragi Ace's class—

text_block_list.name: Guest Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
Fulfilling your dream—self-actualization—
is not something that can be achieved through training alone.
You need the power to express your own feelings and ideals.

text_block_list.name: Guest Lecturer
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I'd like everyone to work in groups to create an art piece. A painting, a sculpture, whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Guest Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
However, you must decide on a theme to express.
This is an exercise in self-actualization. —Begin!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Aargh, I just can't make up my mind!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I feel at my wit's end, you see.
Pulling it all together into a single work is quite the—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone has so much personality, after all♪
CB-chan wants to go outside, Ramonu-chan wants to paint at her own leisure—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And Maruzen wants it to be 'fab'.
Sirius doesn't agree either... mm-mm-mm...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—That's it!!
Hey, why don't we just do it with all the toppings?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, keep your eyes on me too, Trainer!
I've got a bit of an idea!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~, what a nice breeze. You really get way more inspiration outside after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
――Ah. Something's shining over there.
Is it a stone? Doesn't it look like it could be material for my artwork?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're right! That's a super rare color!
Let's take this with us!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sequins, tinsel chenille, and some appliqués for that extra cute touch... Yep, absolutely perfect!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"With this much, everyone should be able to show their true 'colors'.
After all, we've gathered all these 'collars'—err, colors...!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
An oil painting, huh?
...So, have you decided what you're going to paint?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Now then. Follow your heart's desire.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Guess so.
Still, not knowing what the finished piece will look like is half the fun.
Maybe I'll pick up the brush again after all this time.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —And then, paste this right here...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright, it's complete!!

text_block_list.name: Guest Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
Next up, Katsuragi Ace's group.
What kind of piece did you create?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Right here!!
This is what we made!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Loaded with all of everyone's ideas!!
A special mask!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Made by cutting and pasting the materials everyone brought, the mask was a chaotic blend of artistry, retro vibes, nature, and grade-schooler sensibility...!"

text_block_list.name: Guest Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is... quite incredible, isn't it...?
Um, what might the theme of this piece be...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: A theme? ...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —I totally forgot!!

text_block_list.name: Guest Lecturer
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wait, come to think of it,
weren't we supposed to decide on a theme?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I totally forgot about it too...
I was having way too much fun, you know?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Aha, hahaha! I was just so determined to make something super interesting that I got totally carried away!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, having a theme is mandatory. What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
How about "Chaos"?
It fits our current situation perfectly, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You've got a point!? But is that really what I wanted
to express in the first place? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! Trainer!
What do you think the theme for this is?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of the blue, the question was turned back onto me.
If I were to find a theme in that eccentric mask,
what on earth could it be...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Aptly put.
It is truly a piece brought together by
individuals of strong personality sharing their ideas.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great, it's a deal then!!
I'm counting on you, Sensei!

text_block_list.name: Guest Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
I... see? ...Well yes, clashing personalities
can certainly be considered a form of self-expression.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though quite intense, Katsuragi Ace and the others created an intriguing piece.
They even earned a perfect score flower-stamp from the OG instructor!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the interpretation to the beholder...
That, too, is a form of art.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds great! Well then, Sensei,
I'll leave it to the viewer's interpretation, so you pick the theme!

text_block_list.name: Guest Lecturer
text_block_list.text: Th... This...

text_block_list.name: Guest Lecturer
text_block_list.text: That is NOT the point of this lesson!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The lecturer fired off a passionate comeback,
and everyone shrugged their shoulders together.
